title: Revoke job group visibility
description: P0 request to narrow an admission-bound group audience to submitter-only. The API checks owner or job-specific steward, CSRF, and a strong If-Match; records an append-only audit event; and never copies the untrusted reason into status, SSE, or API errors.

reason.description: Required explanation for privileged group revocation. Escape for audit storage/display; restrict audit access.
